boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten current SUNY Geneseo traditions documented by the Undergraduate Alumni Association’s annual Traditions Challenge.

cards.title: Show Your Class Pride
cards.subtitle: Class pride pin tradition
cards.notes: Pick up your class pride pin at First Knight or the Student Org Expo, then display it somewhere you will see it during the year.
cards.short_summary: A visible class-year marker tied to Geneseo’s UAA traditions program.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists showing class pride as an Annual Traditions Challenge activity.
cards.access_notes: The UAA lists this as a current Annual Traditions Challenge activity; no cost to participate is stated on the page.

cards.title: Paint the Tree
cards.subtitle: UAA Annual Traditions Challenge
cards.notes: Document the painted tree when your organization or cause is represented, and follow campus and organization guidance before taking part.
cards.short_summary: A recurring campus-tree tradition included in Geneseo’s current challenge.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists “Paint the Tree” among its current Annual Traditions Challenge activities.
cards.access_notes: The UAA identifies this as a current tradition and states there is no cost to participate in the challenge.

cards.title: Capture a Sunset at the Gazebo
cards.subtitle: Campus gazebo tradition
cards.notes: Visit the gazebo near sunset and take a photo from a public, open area; check weather and daylight conditions before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A photo-based sunset tradition centered on Geneseo’s gazebo.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists capturing a sunset at the Gazebo as an Annual Traditions Challenge activity.
cards.access_notes: The UAA marks this tradition as photo-required and states there is no cost to participate in the challenge.

cards.title: Lounge on the College Green
cards.subtitle: College Green or Sturges Quad tradition
cards.notes: Bring a book, blanket, or a friend and spend time on the College Green; take a photo if you want to document the challenge.
cards.short_summary: A campus-green gathering ritual recognized by the UAA.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists lounging on the College Green or Sturges Quad as an Annual Traditions Challenge activity.
cards.access_notes: The UAA marks this as photo-required and states there is no cost to participate in the challenge.

cards.title: Visit the Roemer Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Campus arboretum tradition
cards.notes: Take a daytime walk through the Roemer Arboretum and photograph a seasonal detail or landmark while staying on public paths.
cards.short_summary: An arboretum visit is one of Geneseo’s listed challenge traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists visiting the Roemer Arboretum or Letchworth State Park as an Annual Traditions Challenge activity.
cards.access_notes: The UAA lists this as a current challenge activity and states there is no cost to participate in the challenge.

cards.title: Snap a Picture at Emmeline Fountain
cards.subtitle: Emmeline fountain tradition
cards.notes: Frame a photo in front of the Emmeline fountain from the surrounding public walkway, leaving space for others using the area.
cards.short_summary: A fountain-photo ritual in the UAA’s campus traditions list.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists taking a picture in front of the Emmeline fountain as an Annual Traditions Challenge activity.
cards.access_notes: The UAA marks this as photo-required and states there is no cost to participate in the challenge.

cards.title: Cheer on the Knights
cards.subtitle: SUNY Geneseo athletics spirit tradition
cards.notes: Attend a Knights contest or follow the team with friends, and use the current athletics schedule to choose an accessible event.
cards.short_summary: School-spirit participation is formally included in the UAA challenge.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists cheering on the Knights as an Annual Traditions Challenge activity.
cards.access_notes: The UAA lists this as a current challenge activity and states there is no cost to participate in the challenge.

cards.title: Play Broomball
cards.subtitle: Intramural tradition
cards.notes: Join a broomball session as a player or spectator, and confirm the current intramural schedule and participation requirements first.
cards.short_summary: Broomball is named alongside intramurals in Geneseo’s traditions program.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists playing broomball or other intramurals, including players and fans, as an Annual Traditions Challenge activity.
cards.access_notes: The UAA identifies this as a current challenge activity and states there is no cost to participate in the challenge.

cards.title: Submit a Candid to the E-Yearbook
cards.subtitle: UAA E-Yearbook tradition
cards.notes: Choose a candid that reflects your year, make sure everyone pictured is comfortable with submission, and submit it through the UAA process.
cards.short_summary: A contribution to Geneseo’s continuing student photo record.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists submitting a candid photo to the E-Yearbook as an Annual Traditions Challenge activity.
cards.access_notes: The UAA marks this as photo-required and states there is no cost to participate in the challenge.

cards.title: Attend GREAT Day
cards.subtitle: Geneseo Recognizing Excellence, Achievement & Talent Day
cards.notes: Check the current GREAT Day program, select a session or presentation that interests you, and plan enough time to engage with it.
cards.short_summary: A named campus academic event recognized as a Geneseo tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Geneseo lists attending the Diversity Summit or GREAT Day as an Annual Traditions Challenge activity.
cards.access_notes: The UAA lists this as a current challenge activity and states there is no cost to participate in the challenge.
